subject: biology

hotspots.label: Outer membrane
hotspots.description: The wrapping of the chloroplast that holds everything inside.
hotspots.function: Encloses the chloroplast and its contents.

hotspots.label: Thylakoid stacks (grana)
hotspots.description: The stacks of flat green discs where sunlight is captured.
hotspots.function: Capture light energy to power sugar-making.

hotspots.label: Stroma
hotspots.description: The fluid space around the stacks where sugar is assembled.
hotspots.function: Where carbon dioxide is built into sugar.

hotspots.label: Chlorophyll
hotspots.description: The green pigment that captures energy from sunlight.
hotspots.function: Absorbs light to start the food-making process.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette beneath the model, no floor grid, no scene props. The organelle floats large and centered, lit with soft neutral studio light (no rim glow, no bloom, no emissive anywhere). Clean stylized-specimen quality - museum-model cross-section caps, never gore. COLOR IS RESTRAINED: the organelle reads as a calm warm-paper specimen; each structural part is modeled in a muted near-neutral shade (warm taupe, pale vanilla, soft slate), never a saturated legend color. Strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat-colored hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Interior fluid (if any) is softly translucent but not glassy; cross-section cuts are clean flat museum caps. No emissive channels anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a chloroplast as an oval specimen shown in clean cutaway. Inside: several stacks of flat green discs (thylakoids/grana) connected by thin bridges, floating in the fluid stroma. A soft green tint on the discs reads as chlorophyll but stays muted and non-glowy. Two small incoming arrows (light, water, CO2) and one outgoing arrow (sugar, oxygen) as flat informational marks on the cutaway face. Warm-paper palette, muted greens, no glow. Named nodes: ChloroplastMembrane, Granum01-04, Stroma, ChlorophyllTint. Budget 10-14k.
